clips.title: The story
paras: Daggerspine naga hold the Eastern Strand along Hillsbrad's southeastern coast. The beaches and shallows reach toward the Arathi Highlands border.

The Daggerspine naga hold the Eastern Strand on Hillsbrad's southeastern edge. Across the bay lies the Western Strand. Southshore and Tarren Mill clash over the region's human farms, while the naga dominate these sandy flats and tidelines. They come from the Great Sea, crossing the sandbars and settling among rocky outcrops. From there, they watch the mainland.
